notes:
Summary: SentraFold is a mid-market helpdesk platform adding ML-driven summarization + auto-tagging to reduce handle time and improve TL routing. Primary flows: email -> auto-summarize (1-3 bullet TLDR), produce suggested tags + macros for Zendesk/Freshdesk, agent assist snippets (one-click insert), and automated SLA triage.

What they said: "We need short, consistent summaries for agents to scan 6+ tickets/min. Tagging must be at least 85% precision for routing."

Technical constraints / asks:
- Integration: prefer webhook + macros in Zendesk; Freshdesk workflows for auto-responses. Need examples for both.
- Latency: target p95 < 300ms for agent assist; p99 < 850ms acceptable for background summarization.
- Throughput: baseline 150 req/s; must handle spikes to 500 req/s (30min bursts) without errors.
- Models: prefer small/medium open models with ability to fallback to quantized variant. Want profiling data.
- Data controls: VPC option + customer-managed KMS, 90-day retention default, option to disable logs for selected queues.

POC notes (current):
- Running 2-week POC on 4 high-volume queues (billing, login issues, escalations).
- Initial runs show 78% tag precision; need tuning of training prompts + rule override for product codes.
- Observed latency spike correlated with long conversation context (avg tokens > 1200) — SE suggested KV cache + prefix truncation.

- If spike POC passes, propose 6-month reserved capacity contract + Optimize consult for batching settings.

Stated blockers: procurement timeline (~6 weeks), SOC2 evidence (they require for Dedicated), and final tag precision target (85%+) before production roll-out.
